comment: Blessed from the pinned engine, hand-checked to the dollar: wages-and-k1-ptp-code-z-single plus a 3,000 prior-year unallowed loss from THIS publicly traded partnership, and it MOVES A SERVED LINE. Section 469(k) step 1 combines the current year with the prior-year unallowed loss: 12,000 - 3,000 = an overall GAIN of 9,000, nonpassive in Schedule E column (k), so total income falls by exactly the carry-in, 60,250 -> 57,250, and AGI with it. Standard deduction 15,750, taxable income before QBI 41,500. THE CARRY-IN DOES NOT TOUCH THE SECTION 199A AMOUNT, which is the other half of the measurement: Form 8995 line 6 is still the answered code Z 12,000, line 8 = 12,000, line 9 = 2,400, and the line 14 cap (20% x 41,500 = 8,300) still does not bind, so Form 1040 line 13 is 2,400 here as well. Taxable income 41,500 - 2,400 = 39,100; income tax 4,457 = tax table row 39,100-39,150, midpoint 39,125 (1,192.50 + 12% x 27,200 = 4,456.50, half-up); total tax 4,457, withholding 6,000, overpayment 1,543 — 360 more than the no-carry-in fixture.
